description: An expanse of blue sky dotted with irregularly shaped white clouds stretches out across the bottom two thirds of the canvas. At the top third of the image, the blue meets with a glowing pink sky that expands overhead.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
